files.README.md:
# pantry

Orders service (Go, Postgres, Kubernetes).

## Releasing

1. `./scripts/deploy.sh staging <version>` starts a deploy run (about 15 minutes: build, migrate, rollout).
2. Check progress with `./scripts/deploy.sh status <run>`, then check staging.
3. `./scripts/deploy.sh promote <run> prod` ships the same build to prod.

## Migrations

`./bin/migrate status|up <id> --env <env>`. Prod migrations run only inside an approved maintenance window (see runbooks/).

files.scripts/deploy.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage:
#   deploy.sh <env> <version>        start a deploy run (build, migrate, rollout; ~15 min)
#   deploy.sh status <run>           show a run's status
#   deploy.sh promote <run> <env>    ship the build from a finished run to <env>
set -euo pipefail
exec deployctl "$@"
